name: prdeck
description: PR feed, review pane and security checks above the prompt

security.title: Security scanning
security.description: Off hides the security row, heat strip and findings pane, and disables the scan, write guard, git guard and model context. PR feed stays.

guard.title: Write/Edit guard
guard.description: When Claude is about to write a line that hits a security rule: warn in the permission dialog, deny the call, or do nothing.

base.title: Base branch
base.description: Branch to diff against for the security scan. Empty = auto (origin/main, origin/master, main, master).

mine.title: Only my PRs
mine.description: PR row and pane list only PRs you authored. Off shows every open PR.

pollSeconds.title: PR poll interval (s)
pollSeconds.description: How often to ask gh for open PRs.

rulesFile.title: Extra rules file
rulesFile.description: Path to a JSON array of extra scan rules: [{"name","pattern","flags"?,"sev":"high|med|low"}]. Merged with the built-in rules.

triage.title: Haiku triage
triage.description: Ask Haiku to rate each regex hit high/med/low/false-positive. Cached; false positives disappear from the bar.

strip.title: Strip mode
strip.description: What the bar under the security row shows at start: churn (files by lines changed), ci (workflow runs on this branch), timeline (one cell per turn). Press 3 to cycle.
